history.author: Appsara
history.description: Initial version created based on the confirmed screen designs

purpose: This document explains the purpose of EMS's Container Stock Entry details.
features: Container Stock Entry allows the user to maintain the container type wise stock entry per depot.
The screen has provision to update the stock as per EDI’s received from depot – Update inventory option.
EQC Reserved Cannot be greater than EQC Available

events.description: Search: queries the data based on the entered query fields and shows it in the data grid
events.triggered_when: User clicks Search after entering the query fields

events.description: Reset: clears the query fields at once to query with new data
Edit: makes the EQC Reserved column editable and shows the Add and Save buttons
events.triggered_when: User clicks Edit after querying data

events.description: Add: adds an additional record to enter Container Type, Depot and EQC Reserved
events.triggered_when: User clicks Add after clicking Edit

events.description: Delete: deletes the newly added record
events.triggered_when: User clicks the delete icon of a newly added record

events.description: Save: Edit: saves the edited data and updates the value in EQC Reserved. Add: saves the added data and the new data is added
events.triggered_when: User clicks Save after editing EQC Reserved or entering the new record; EQC Reserved cannot be greater than EQC Available
User clicks the Re-Build icon after querying data

events.description: Booking Details: opens the Booking Details screen; if data is available, an Excel file with the Booking details is downloaded automatically
events.triggered_when: User clicks the Booking Details icon of a record

events.description: Stock: Auto shows the Auto Stock data (view only, not editable); Physical shows the physical stock data
events.triggered_when: User selects Auto or Physical in the Stock drop down

events.description: PR Status: Supplied shows the bookings with Supplied PR status; Prepared shows the bookings with Prepared status
events.triggered_when: User selects Supplied or Prepared in the PR Status drop down of the Booking Details screen
